comment: Advisories tolerated by scripts/audit-gate.cjs. An entry suppresses its advisory ONLY while the advisory stays out of the runtime (production) dependency tree; the gate re-blocks it the moment it reaches runtime, and blocks anything not listed here. List an advisory only when it has no patched release and the sole npm-offered fix is a breaking downgrade of a build-time tool. Re-check each entry when dependencies change and remove it as soon as a real fix ships.

allow.advisory: picomatch vulnerable to ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs
allow.reason: Build-time glob dependency pulled transitively by vite (core-ui) and electron-builder (desktop). No patched release exists — the advisory covers every published version (<=4.0.7) — and npm's only offered fix is a breaking major downgrade of vite / electron-builder. picomatch here matches the developer's own trusted file paths at build time, is never reachable at runtime or on untrusted input, and `npm audit --omit=dev` reports zero vulnerabilities for both packages.
